method.description: Existing readTiffLayout/greyPng with the same centre-row selection and horizontal integer-span box average, rounding to 8-bit. Strict 206 Content-Range/length and consistent ETag; If-Match after initial response. 12 concurrent workers. Original displayed cache never written.

conclusion: Configured current USGS TIFF sampled with the existing pipeline reproduces the cached Vesta PNG exactly, including PNG encoding and all 2,097,152 decoded greyscale samples. This closes the current configured-source/sampler pixel reproduction question. It does not establish historical download provenance or full-source pixel preservation.
limitations: Only TIFF layout and 1024 selected complete rows downloaded, not the full 356659263-byte source. Per-range and concatenated-row SHA256 values are not a full TIFF hash; multipart ETag is not asserted SHA256.
Horizontal averaging and vertical point sampling are a reduced-resolution derivative, not full source-pixel preservation. No visible-RGB, photometric or local chemical calibration established.
2013-12-10 product/publication and 2017-05-01 label revision remain distinct from 2011 acquisition ranges. No per-pixel observation-date claim.
Publisher clear-filter processing, artistic neighboring-pixel wrap-seam fill, preliminary 150-degree east shift and Claudia 146E convention remain as documented; no additional shift applied.
255 km projection sphere is not a replacement for catalogue physical radius 261.4 km. No new angular/raster size computation; only image processing sample-index reproduction.

DEM/feature control, prime-meridian/shape alignment, raw FC UTC/filter/exposure crosswalk, physical accuracy, original PDS edition identity, photometry and licence remain open. No blanket CC BY/public-domain assertion.
All 107 delivered dossiers and every prior native/model/shape/map/original/master/provenance record preserved. No fresh browser verification claim.
